headline: At dx = {dx:+.2f} m, dy = {dy:+.2f} m, hole_pose() puts the hole {pose_error_mm:.1f} mm from where it is, about {ratio:.0f}× the ±{search_mm:g} mm that Astra's policy searches around its estimate. The peg ends {lateral_mm:.1f} mm off after {api_calls} API calls, with a peak force of {max_force_N:.1f} N, well under the 150 N abort, so the policy never notices: {failure_mode}.
quote: Because camera-error bounds and contact stiffness are unspecified, small steps and an early force threshold reduce risk but cannot guarantee avoiding the 150 N abort threshold
